loop_join: The final beat p14 (short308_14.png, a plain near-black surface with faint horizontal grain) is held under the FULL CASE card and rewound in place so it never hard-cuts; that near-black hold echoes the tone of frame 0, p01 (short308_01.png, the dark utility control room at night), so when Shorts auto-repeats the loop lands back on another dark control-room frame instead of jumping to a lit image.
second_watch_detail: p13 (short308_13.png) shows a single unlabelled descending line filling a dark screen under L8; on a first watch it reads as a generic system graph, but once L5 has given the real numbers -- 59.4 Hz held for 4:23 against a 9-minute failure line -- that descending line is the frequency chart itself, and L8's 4:37 is how close a second, unseen line came to the same edge.
